# Action reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_docs.py from `src/Main.ahk --list-actions`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Actions are what bindings, tray items, and gestures run. Reference one by id;
pass `args` as a JSON array in the order listed under **Arguments**
(`[name]` means optional). Plugins can register more actions; see
[plugins.md](plugins.md).

## apps

| Action | Arguments | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `app.cycle` | app id | Switch between an app's windows, or launch it |
| `app.launch` | app id | Launch an app |
| `app.toggle` | app id | Focus, minimize, or launch an app |
| `hotkey.trigger` | hotkey | Trigger another hotkey by its notation |
| `run` | command, [options], [workingDir] | Run a command line |
| `run.wait` | command, [options], [workingDir] | Run a command line and wait for it |
| `send` | keys | Send keystrokes (AutoHotkey Send syntax) |
| `sendText` | text | Type literal text |

## core

| Action | Arguments | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `app.editConfig` |  | Open config.json in the default editor |
| `app.exit` |  | Exit hotkit |
| `app.openConfigFolder` |  | Open the config folder |
| `app.reload` |  | Reload scripts and config |
| `app.showProblems` |  | List config problems |
| `bindings.disableGroup` | group | Turn a binding group off |
| `bindings.enableGroup` | group | Turn a binding group on |
| `bindings.toggleGroup` | group | Turn a binding group on or off |
| `layer.activate` | layer | Switch to a layer |
| `layer.next` |  | Switch to the next layer |
| `layer.previous` |  | Switch to the previous layer |
| `osd.toggle` |  | Show or hide the keyboard shortcut overlay |

## desktop

| Action | Arguments | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `desktop.focus` |  | Focus the desktop without minimizing windows, so system shortcuts reach Windows |
| `keyboard.toggleCapsLock` |  | Toggle Caps Lock (even when forced off) |
| `keyboard.toggleNumLock` |  | Toggle Num Lock (even when forced on) |
| `media.next` |  | Next track |
| `media.playPause` |  | Play/pause media |
| `media.previous` |  | Previous track |
| `powerToys.toggleAwake` |  | Toggle PowerToys Awake between indefinite and off |
| `taskbar.activate` | n | Like Win+<n>: start, switch to, or cycle taskbar app n (1-10; 0 = 10), even under a full-screen app |
| `theme.toggle` |  | Toggle Windows light/dark theme (and wallpaper) |
| `trayIcons.showAll` |  | Promote every tray icon to the visible area |
| `wallpaper.bing` |  | Set today's Bing image as wallpaper |
| `wallpaper.set` | path, [style] | Set the desktop wallpaper |

## displayBrightness

| Action | Arguments | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `brightness.adjust` | delta | Adjust monitor brightness |
| `brightness.adjustExternal` | delta | Adjust external (DDC/CI) monitor brightness |
| `brightness.decrease` |  | Decrease monitor brightness |
| `brightness.increase` |  | Increase monitor brightness |
| `brightness.set` | percent | Set monitor brightness |
| `brightness.setExternal` | percent | Set external (DDC/CI) monitor brightness |
| `brightness.swap` | target percent | Toggle brightness between a level and the last used level |
| `gamma.decrease` |  | Decrease software (gamma) brightness |
| `gamma.increase` |  | Increase software (gamma) brightness |
| `gamma.set` | percent | Set software (gamma) brightness |
| `gamma.toggle` |  | Toggle software (gamma) brightness |
| `monitors.refresh` |  | Re-detect monitors |
| `nightLight.decrease` |  | Decrease Night Light strength |
| `nightLight.increase` |  | Increase Night Light strength |
| `nightLight.set` | percent | Set Night Light strength |
| `nightLight.toggle` |  | Toggle Windows Night Light |

## displayScale

| Action | Arguments | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `displayScale.decrease` | [monitor] | Decrease display scale |
| `displayScale.increase` | [monitor] | Increase display scale |
| `displayScale.set` | percent, [monitor] | Set display scale |
| `displayScale.show` | [monitor] | Show display scale |

## power

| Action | Arguments | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `monitors.off` |  | Turn all monitors off until the next input; works with Keep Screen On |
| `power.allOff` |  | Disable Keep Awake, Keep Screen On and Keep Unlocked |
| `power.keepAwake.off` |  | Disable Keep Awake |
| `power.keepAwake.on` | [minutes] | Enable Keep Awake (the PC doesn't sleep), with an optional time limit |
| `power.keepAwake.toggle` | [minutes] | Enable or disable Keep Awake (the PC doesn't sleep), with an optional time limit |
| `power.keepScreenOn.off` |  | Disable Keep Screen On |
| `power.keepScreenOn.on` | [minutes] | Enable Keep Screen On (the screen stays on and the PC stays awake), with an optional time limit |
| `power.keepScreenOn.toggle` | [minutes] | Enable or disable Keep Screen On (the screen stays on and the PC stays awake), with an optional time limit |
| `power.keepUnlocked.off` |  | Disable Keep Unlocked |
| `power.keepUnlocked.on` | [minutes] | Enable Keep Unlocked (the screen stays on and the screen saver is paused), with an optional time limit |
| `power.keepUnlocked.toggle` | [minutes] | Enable or disable Keep Unlocked (the screen stays on and the screen saver is paused), with an optional time limit |

## quickWindows

| Action | Arguments | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `quickWindow.create` | quick window id | Open another quick window |
| `quickWindow.cycle` | quick window id | Cycle through a quick window's windows |
| `quickWindow.cycleMode` | quick window id | Switch a quick window's launch mode |
| `quickWindow.detach` | quick window id | Release windows back to normal behavior |
| `quickWindow.showAll` | quick window id | Reveal all of a quick window's windows |
| `quickWindow.toggle` | quick window id | Show or hide a quick window (launches if needed) |

## windows

| Action | Arguments | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `taskView.open` |  | Open Windows Task View |
| `window.activateLast` | [winTitle] | Activate the most recent other window (optionally matching a WinTitle) |
| `window.bringForward` |  | Bring the active window in front of the next window it overlaps |
| `window.bringToFront` |  | Bring the active window in front of all other windows |
| `window.cycleNext` |  | Focus the next window, like Alt+Tab; with a modifier, repeat while holding it |
| `window.cyclePrevious` |  | Focus the previous window, like Shift+Alt+Tab; with a modifier, repeat while holding it |
| `window.focusNext` |  | Focus the next window in z-order |
| `window.sendBackward` |  | Send the active window behind the next window it overlaps (keeps focus) |
| `window.sendToBack` |  | Send the active window behind all other windows (keeps focus) |
| `window.toggleAlwaysOnTop` |  | Pin or unpin the active window |
| `window.toggleMinimized` |  | Minimize the active window, or restore the last one minimized |
